start.speaker: The Widow
start.text: You are on my landing. I have had this landing eleven years and I do not intend to argue about it, so state your business or go around. Are you going up? I can walk. I have been telling myself that for a while now.

choices.text: I am going down, not up.

taken.speaker: The Widow
taken.text: Then the stair is ours until the ascent. I will not slow you if you do not leave me behind.

left.speaker: The Widow
left.text: Then take your descent. The landing remains mine, and I will be here when you choose ascent.

committed.speaker: The Widow
committed.text: The landing is yours until the ascent. Do not make me regret lending it.

already.speaker: An empty landing
already.text: Somebody sat here long enough to wear the stone smooth. Whoever it was is not sitting here now.
